observed_fact: Search screen described for stores where products can be received, searchable by bookstore-name fragment or bookstore code.
governance_implication: Probe search parameters and codes as source_record_id.

governance_implication: Authoritative association/network context; 2,300+ is umbrella/member aspiration, not current active marketplace count.
